host: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D, Linux x86-64, rustc 1.97.1; Rapier 0.36.1 f64. WebGPU playback on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090.

cost_protocol.25ns: Five pinned batches per case on CPU 8. Each batch warms a fresh world, then times four new worlds. Case order reverses each round. p95 is nearest rank, 19th of 20. An additional 20-run block on CPUs 9–12 is provided as a cross-check.
cost_protocol.1ns: One pinned 20-sample block per case after warmup; one independent core per mirror/gap (9–12). Mirrored order reverses baseline/candidate order. Each sample initializes a fresh Bevy world. The public first tick alone is timed and all six bodies are compared outside the timed interval.

changed_coverage.method: Distinct changed executable lines and code region coordinates covered by the exact binaries, excluding cfg(test) sections and test definitions.

moderate_window_reproduction.schedule: When approach_ns is positive, use that target step until center minus guard, fine_ns until center plus guard, and post_ns until the original prefix end. First three intervals use ordinary solver iterations. The fourth uses 15,625 ns steps and 8 temporal x 8 PGS iterations until the end of the 1 ms public tick. Ceil segment duration divided by target timestep for step count and evenly distribute integer nanoseconds. A zero approach_ns means the full original fine prefix. Subsequent ticks each have one ordinary native call.
